text: Lenovo, Formula 1's league-level partner, is listed in Hong Kong (992) and its largest shareholder is Legend Holdings Corporation with about 31.4% - Legend's own annual report records both that holding and Chinese Academy of Sciences Holdings Co., Ltd. (CAS Holdings) as a substantial shareholder with roughly 29% of Legend. There is therefore a real but indirect Chinese state (CAS) interest of only about 9% economic - 'concern', not 'serious'. Human-rights relevance: Chinese state-linked ownership and hardware supply-chain/labour exposure.
